issue_context.title: Environment Canada doesn't report temperature high/low
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

Environment Canada's weather integration is not showing extrema, after a bit of research this appears to be due to the way it reports the forecast. 

If we look at the way the weather card present the High/Low data, it's clearly expecting the current day's forecast data to also be returned as the first entry of the forecast array. At this line is a check for the first element from the forecast array with `today`. If it is found highTemp / lowTemp will be used, else it is not: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/blob/e69f36047da6b168fd5a660c553f15557239c953/src/data/weather.ts#L214

Indeed, if I compare the EC forecast with DarkSky, where these data values are working. DarkSky includes today as the first element of the forecast result.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1007595/106541155-717da680-64cf-11eb-9677-71d3dd0bb86d.png)


**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

Home Assistant 2021.1.5

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

I don't believe it ever worked.

**What type of installation are you running?**

Home Assistant Container

**Integration causing the issue**

environment_canada

**Link to integration documentation on our website**

_No response_

**Example YAML snippet**

```yaml
weather:
  - platform: darksky
    api_key: !secret darksky_api_key
    latitude: <omitted>
    longitude: <omitted>
    units: ca
    name: <omitted>
    mode: daily
  - platform: environment_canada
    name: <omitted>
    station: "PROVINCE/station_code <omitted>"
```

**Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?**

_No Response_
comments: Thanks, this didn't exist when I developed the component. It should be simple enough to add. Because Environment Canada does their forecasts by half-days I'll probably use the next low and the next high, the latter of which will be from the next day in the evenings. Edit: Fixed. I think this was only an issue in the evenings after all.

review_comments:
The time should be UTC time.
